publishedRecipe.name: Italian Sausage Soup with Rotini Pasta, Bell Pepper, Tomato & Spinach

instructions.primary_message: Peel, halve, and small dice onion.
Preheat a large pot over medium heat.
While the pot heats up, use the tip of a knife to slice down the length of each sausage; peel off casings and discard.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion, garlic, sausage, and spices; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until sausage is brown and crumbly, 5-7 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
4 tsp extra virgin olive oil
2 tsp parsley flakes
2 tsp oregano, dried
1 tsp thyme, dried
1 tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry bell peppers; using a clean cutting board, trim, seed, and small dice.
When the sausage is done, add bell pepper to the pot and stir to combine. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, 3-4 minutes more.
Add broth, tomatoes, water, pasta, and vinegar to the pot; stir to combine. Cover and bring to a boil; once boiling, reduce heat to medium, and simmer until pasta is cooked through, about 8 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
32 fl oz (4 cups) chicken or vegetable broth
2 (14.5 oz) cans diced tomatoes
2 cup water
6 oz rotini pasta
3 tbsp balsamic vinegar

instructions.primary_message: While the soup is simmering, wash and dry the spinach (skip this step if the spinach came pre-washed), then roughly chop.
Add spinach to the soup in handfuls, waiting for the spinach to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Stir to combine and remove from heat.
To serve, divide the soup between bowls and top with Parmesan. Enjoy!
